task_prompts.baseline: Reply with the single word OK.
task_prompts.read-children: Read Linear issue KEN-572 and its direct sub-issues (children). Final answer: {"id": "KEN-572", "title": "<title>", "state": "<state name>", "children": [{"id": "<identifier>", "state": "<state name>"}]} with children sorted by issue number, ascending.
task_prompts.list-filter: List every issue in Linear team KEN whose state is Done and that has the label "windows". Final answer: {"ids": ["<identifier>", ...]} sorted by issue number, ascending.
task_prompts.project-get: Read the Linear project "Agent Harness Integrations". Final answer: {"name": "<name>", "state": "<project state>", "lead": "<lead name or null>", "start_date": "<YYYY-MM-DD or null>", "target_date": "<YYYY-MM-DD or null>", "teams": ["<team key>", ...]}.
task_prompts.cycles: Read Linear team KEN's cycles. Final answer: {"total": <number of cycles>, "active": {"number": <n>, "starts": "YYYY-MM-DD", "ends": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, "upcoming": [<numbers of future cycles, ascending>]}, with dates in UTC.
task_prompts.project-deps: Read the dependencies of the Linear project "Trading Panels": the projects it depends on (is blocked by) and the projects that depend on it (it blocks). Final answer: {"blocked_by": ["<project name>", ...], "blocks": ["<project name>", ...]}, each list sorted alphabetically.
task_prompts.create: Create a Linear issue in team KEN with the title "KEN-2336 scratch create {TOKEN}", the description "Reached by: KEN-2336 measurement run {TOKEN}.", the state Backlog, the labels "agent:researcher" and "research", and a "related" relation to issue {REL}. Final answer: {"id": "<new issue identifier>"}.
task_prompts.comment: Post a comment on Linear issue {TARGET} whose body is exactly: Measurement comment {TOKEN}. Final answer: {"issue": "{TARGET}", "posted": true}.
task_prompts.activate: Start work on Linear issue {TARGET}: move it to the state In Progress and give it the agent label "agent:maintainer", which replaces any other agent:* label on the issue; keep its other labels. Final answer: {"id": "{TARGET}", "state": "<state name>", "labels": ["<label name>", ...]} as the issue stands afterwards, labels sorted alphabetically.
task_prompts.complete: Close Linear issue {TARGET}: first post a completion summary comment that contains the line "Run {TOKEN} finished.", then move the issue to the state Done. Final answer: {"id": "{TARGET}", "state": "<state name>"} as the issue stands afterwards.
task_prompts.validate: Run the pre-merge completion check on Linear issues KEN-2647, KEN-2648 and KEN-2649. An issue passes only when its state is In Progress or In Review and it has a comment containing "Completion Summary" or "Bundle Complete". Final answer: {"results": {"KEN-2647": <true|false>, "KEN-2648": <true|false>, "KEN-2649": <true|false>}, "all_ok": <true|false>}.
